newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates sag at close on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates sag at close on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated on Friday between 14 and 16 percent, but plunged to 10 percent near the close on surplus funds, dealers said.
"Overnight rates see-sawed during the short trading day. But at the end of trading hours, the rates dipped to 10 percent due to surplus liquidity in the system," a dealer said.
Moslem Pakistan works a half-day on Fridays.
Dealers said the market managed to square itself and no discounting was reported at State (central) Bank of Pakistan counters.
